description: Create a wallet owned by a named human. Cannot spend until a policy is granted.
name: create_wallet

description: Balance, frozen state, today's spend, active policy.
name: get_wallet

description: Owner grants the spending scope; returns a plain-language liability receipt.
name: set_policy

description: Sandbox faucet (simulated test USDC) for demos/tests.
name: fund_wallet

description: Dry-run: returns allow / approve / deny with the reason.
name: check_payment

description: Execute inside scope; reject outside it; queue for approval above the threshold.
name: pay

description: Owner resolves a queued payment request (approve).
name: approve_payment

description: Owner resolves a queued payment request (deny).
name: deny_payment

description: Kill switch — freeze the wallet instantly.
name: revoke
